name: Samantha Wood
title: Communications and public relations professional
bio_short: Communications and PR professional with 16+ years' experience in UK and Middle East. Former Director of Corporate Communications, Hilton Worldwide Middle East & Africa. Clients include SWISS Air Lines, TAG Heuer and Jordan Tourism Board. Fellow Member of MEPRA.
bio: Samantha is a dynamic communications and public relations professional with over 16 years' in-house and consultancy experience in the United Kingdom and the Middle East across a diverse range of industries. She has worked in hospitality, food and beverage, aviation and tourism, IT, automotive, transport, finance and fashion/retail. She is skilled at developing and implementing strong communication campaigns for numerous organisations including Hilton Worldwide and its portfolio of ten brands, Inter-Continental Hotels, SWISS Air Lines, Jordan Tourism Board, General Electric, TAG Heuer and The Body Shop. Samantha was Director of Corporate Communications for Hilton Worldwide in Middle East and Africa, based in Dubai, where she was responsible for external and internal communications including media and owner relations, spokesperson profiling, change management campaigns, reputation management, as well as media and crisis communications training. Samantha is a Fellow Member of the Middle East PR Association (MEPRA) and founder of restaurant review website FooDiva. Aside from English, she is fluent in Greek and has a good understanding of French.
bio_long: Samantha is a dynamic communications and public relations professional with over 16 years' in-house and consultancy experience in the United Kingdom and the Middle East across a diverse range of industries. She has worked in hospitality, food and beverage, aviation and tourism, IT, automotive, transport, finance and fashion/retail. She is skilled at developing and implementing strong communication campaigns for numerous organisations including Hilton Worldwide and its portfolio of ten brands, Inter-Continental Hotels, SWISS Air Lines, Jordan Tourism Board, General Electric, TAG Heuer and The Body Shop. Samantha was Director of Corporate Communications for Hilton Worldwide in Middle East and Africa, based in Dubai, where she was responsible for external and internal communications including media and owner relations, spokesperson profiling, change management campaigns, reputation management, as well as media and crisis communications training. Previously she was Hilton's Regional Marketing Manager for Arabian Peninsula. PR agency roles include Hilton's Account Director at ASDA'A Burson Marsteller in the Middle East. Samantha is a Fellow Member and active supporter of the Middle East PR Association (MEPRA) and founder of restaurant review website FooDiva. Aside from English, she is fluent in Greek and has a good understanding of French. Her extensive experience managing communications for one of the world's largest hospitality brands gives her deep expertise in reputation management, stakeholder communications and crisis preparedness in service industries where brand perception directly impacts commercial performance.
